words.definition: a building where people live
words.example: My house has three bedrooms.

words.definition: a part of a building with walls, used for one purpose
words.example: The living room is big.

words.definition: a room where people cook food
words.example: Mother cooks dinner in the kitchen.

words.definition: a room where you sleep
words.example: I sleep in my bedroom.

words.definition: a room with a bath or shower and a toilet
words.example: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.

words.definition: a flat object that opens and closes to let people go in or out
words.example: Please close the door.

words.definition: an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
words.example: I open the window in the morning.

words.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
words.example: We eat dinner at the table.

words.definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on
words.example: Sit on this chair.

words.definition: a piece of furniture for sleeping
words.example: The cat sleeps on my bed.

words.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
words.example: We watch TV on the sofa.

words.definition: a light that uses electricity or oil
words.example: Turn on the lamp, please.

words.definition: one of the sides of a room or building
words.example: There is a picture on the wall.

words.definition: the flat part of a room that you walk on
words.example: The floor is very clean.

words.definition: the top part of a building that covers it
words.example: Snow falls on the roof.

words.definition: a piece of land near a house where you grow flowers or plants
words.example: We have flowers in our garden.

words.definition: a small metal object used to open or lock a door
words.example: I lost my house key.

words.definition: a piece of glass that shows your picture
words.example: She looks in the mirror.

words.definition: a flat board for putting things on
words.example: The books are on the shelf.

words.definition: a machine that shows the time
words.example: The clock is on the wall.

text: My family has a small house in the city. Our house has four rooms: a kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom, and a living room. In the kitchen, there is a table and four chairs. We eat breakfast there every morning. The living room has a big sofa and a lamp near the window. I like to sit on the sofa and read books from the shelf. My bedroom is next to the bathroom. There is a bed, a mirror, and a small clock on the wall. Every night, I look at the clock before I sleep. Behind the house, we have a garden with flowers and a tree. My father works in the garden on weekends. The door of our house is blue, and I always keep my key in my bag. The floor in the kitchen is white, and the roof is red. I love my house because it is warm and happy.
